canonical_data: Per-colony directory holding a SQLite tracker ledger, a file-backed task plan, session cursors, and scoped Markdown memory files under ~/.hive
current_repo_note: Covers the open-source Hive repository: the core framework runtime, the aden_tools MCP tool package, the web dashboard, and the browser extension. The optional Hive LLM router at llm.open-hive.com and the hosted documentation at adenhq.com are vendor-operated services outside the Apache-2.0 licence reviewed here; the runtime also works with other model providers.
strengths: One loop primitive serves as both the lead agent and every worker clone, so crash-safe park and resume, doom-loop detection, and judge-gated termination are inherited by every agent rather than wired per graph
A shared SQLite tracker plus a file-backed task plan gives the colony queryable state that survives a crash, and the Queen validates progress with SELECT queries rather than in-memory counters
Human escalation is out-of-band through an account-bound Slack or Telegram channel, so any agent can park for a person without a node in a graph
weaknesses: The core package is at version 0.7.1 and the repository was created in January 2026, so interfaces and the colony model are still moving
The cost-guard pipeline stage reviewed rejects a request only when an earlier stage supplies an estimated cost, so the README's budget-enforcement claim was not confirmed as an automatic spend cap
The quickstart offers the vendor's own Hive LLM router as a default provider choice, a hosted dependency that the repository licence does not cover
why_it_matters: A young but unusually complete open-source take on long-running multi-agent work, replacing hand-wired agent graphs with one self-cloning loop and durable shared state.
